title: Tofu, Rice and Beetroot Burgers in Teriyaki Sauce
subtitle: with potato and brown rice
description: Plant-based burger patties of tofu, beetroot, brown rice and mashed potato, pan-fried and finished in a homemade sticky teriyaki sauce.

steps.text: Peel and cube the potatoes, cover with water, boil, then reduce the heat and cook until tender. Drain and mash.
Meanwhile make the teriyaki sauce. In a small pot combine the soy sauce, sake, mirin and 3/4 cup water, add the brown sugar and ground ginger and bring to the boil over medium heat.
Mix 1 heaped tablespoon cornflour with 1/4 cup water until dissolved and add to the sauce. Whisk until thickened and remove from the heat. Set aside.

Heat a little oil in a frying pan and fry the chopped onion, garlic and grated ginger for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly soft and golden. Add the chopped beetroot and fry for about 2 more minutes.

Squeeze the tofu well and crumble it into small crumbs. Add it to the pan with the beetroot, season with spices, salt and pepper and fry for about 2 more minutes. Remove from the heat and cool slightly.
In a bowl combine the cooked rice and mashed potato, add the tofu and beetroot mixture and mix well, preferably with your hands. Adjust the seasoning.
Shape into 12 burger patties and dust them with cornflour on both sides.
Heat oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the patties in batches for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden.
Pour some of the sauce into the pan and let it warm with the patties for about 30 seconds. Serve on plates or on bun halves with a little hot sauce and vegetables of your choice.
